item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez criticized the growing push to close borders, saying countries should reject isolationism and embrace openness. “Against those who close themselves off, we must open up. Against those who build walls, we must build alliances.”
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez criticized the growing push to close borders, saying countries should reject isolationism and embrace openness. “Against those who close themselves off, we must open up. Against those who build walls, we must build alliances.”
